articles.summary: TE Connectivity plc (NYSE: TEL) today reported results for the fiscal fourth quarter and fiscal year ended September 25, 2026. Fourth Quarter Highlights Net sales were a record $5.3 billion, an increase of 12% on a reported basis and 13% organically year over year, driven by strong growth in both the Industrial and Transportation segments. Orders of $6.1 billion, an increase of 29% year over year and 6% sequentially. GAAP diluted earnings per share (EPS) from continuing operations was $3.10, up 39% year over year. Adjusted EPS was $3.14, an increase of 21% year over year. GAAP Operating margin was 21% and adjusted operating margin was 22%, driven by strong operational performance across both segments. Cash flow from operating activities was $1.5 billion and free cash flow was $1.2 billion, with approximately $800 million returned to shareholders.
